n: USB Converter with HDMI® and Analog Audio Input (HD-CONV-USB-300)
d: HD-CONV-USB-300 USB Converter with HDMI® and Analog Audio Input

specs.label: Output Signal Type
specs.value: USB 3.0 supporting UVC; HDMI 2.0 (DVI 1.0 compatible) loop out port with support for HDCP 2.2/1.x

specs.label: Input Resolution
specs.value: 4K UHD @ 60 fps 4:4:4 with support for 12‑bit HDR

specs.label: Output Resolution
specs.value: USB: HD 1080p @ 60 fps uncompressed; HDMI: 4K UHD @ 60 fps 4:4:4 with support for 12‑bit HDR

specs.label: Audio input signal type
specs.value: HDMI or analog audio input (selectable in configuration software)

specs.label: USB
specs.value: USB 3.0 device supporting UVC and UAC

specs.label: USB bus powered
specs.value: Works with USB 3.0 and USB 2.0 ports. For USB 2.0, use of a Y-cable connected to two USB 2.0 ports is required to properly power the HD-CONV-USB-300. Power consumption varies depending on the input resolution, use of USB

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Freestanding, surface mountable, or attachment to a rack rail
